mechanism: St. John's wort induces CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, reducing amitriptyline plasma concentrations and therapeutic efficacy, while concurrent serotonergic activity increases serotonin syndrome risk.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if combination necessary, monitor for reduced antidepressant efficacy and serotonin syndrome symptoms; consider alternative herbal products or adjustment of amitriptyline dosing.
